reviews.text: Artesian built our pool, fire pit, and outdoor kitchen area in 2017. The design was the best we were presented from numerous pool designers/builders. The process was rather standard, and Greg was available to answer questions and provide updates. The only major concern we have with the construction was their suggestion to use chlorine over salt, and the location and size of our equipment pad, which ate up a majority of the space that was left in our backyard. After a year many questions sent over email or text went unanswered, and we were left to find someone else for repairs and to ask any construction related questions to. If you choose to use Artesian, make sure there is an understanding on support after the pool is constructed and that they will be around to answer questions.
reviews.author: Noel Geren

reviews.text: We absolutely LOVE our pool, patio and outdoor kitchen area. The design exceeded our expectation and made me fall in love with my house all over again. This is our favorite area of our home now and couldn't be happier with the way it turned out. Greg was wonderful to work with. His attention to detail and knowledge is very impressive and he was a pleasure to work with.  We would HIGHLY recommend him, especially over the big production pool companies!
reviews.author: Dana Martin

reviews.text: It is a very busy season for pool builders in 2021, however, I would expect a reply of some sort from a company when you reach out to them for services, especially a purchase this size.  After filling out their contact page and calling them to leave a message, I have yet to hear anything from them -  multiple weeks after the fact.  I hear that Artesian is a smaller builder and picks their projects, not taking all requests.  Again, that's fine, but let your potential customers know where they stand at least.
reviews.author: Scott Marsh

reviews.text: We were extremely happy with our experience with Greg and Artesian Pools.  He worked with us patiently during the design phase and they did a superb job on the overall project.
reviews.author: Michael Kunze

reviews.text: Artesian Custom Pools were amazing from start to finish. They helped me to design my pool area and was very patient and helpful. They also would always answer my calls throughout the process and helped me with any issues/questions I had. Recommended!!
reviews.author: Scarlett Taylor

reviews.text: I hired Artesian Custom Pools for building a small swimming pool in my backyard. I found them pretty much creative and attentive. In a few weeks I got a star shaped swimming pool with all  modern accessories. Thank You for your great work!
reviews.author: Carol Gibson

reviews.text: Very pleased with the work Greg and team did for us. Love the pool and outdoor kitchen, the entire process was smooth and easy. Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sean Green

data.summary: The Google reviews appear authentic and tell a coherent story of a generally well-regarded but smaller contractor who can be selective/unresponsive to new leads and where some customers have post-construction regrets on specific design elements. The perfect scores on Yelp and Angi are based on extremely low review counts and do not reflect the more nuanced reality shown on Google. There is no strong evidence of fake review generation, but potential for platform manipulation or selective review solicitation exists.
fake_signals: Yelp/Angi ratings are perfect but based on very low review volume (4 and 1 review respectively)
Potential for selective solicitation on certain platforms
authentic_signals: Specific details in reviews (Greg as owner, project types like outdoor kitchens, equipment pad issues)
Varied writing styles and timeframes (reviews span 11 years)
Mix of praise and constructive criticism in Google reviews
Negative reviews contain specific, credible complaints about communication and design choices
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating discrepancy between Google (3.7) and Yelp/Angi (4.9/5.0). Google reviews show a mix of positive and negative experiences, while Yelp/Angi show only perfect scores with very few reviews.
